title: The most fun I've had with Claude: it made my game's trailer from nothing but the game
author: Medium_Aspect_8784
selftext:
Of everything I've done with Claude Code, making the videos for my game has been the most fun by a mile.  
  
There are no external assets. No stock footage, no music library, nothing from outside the game. Claude has the code, so it knows what the game does. It runs the game in a headless browser, stages every shot, films it frame by frame at 4K and writes the music in code. The gunshots and oinks are the game's own, and they're made in code too.  
  
My whole brief for the latest trailer was one paragraph: "intense, mad and frenetic... Include multiple short clips of the bar, piano, dancing scenes" It followed every word of it.  
  
The bit that got me: it knew how the game's saloon piano works, so it retuned it to the trailer's tempo. The pianist and all forty dancing pigs are on the beat.  
  
If you've made a game with Claude, ask it for a trailer.  
  
Mine is Hog Noon, a Wild West game about pigs.

comments.author: fapfap_ahh
comments.body: Good start and result! I did pretty much the same thing with my game to see what Claude could achieve with my artistic direction

replies.author: Medium_Aspect_8784
replies.body: Thanks, yes when I found out this was possible I made a video where Claude added a commentary as it played a puzzle game. It's really handy too for testing - it can make video showing extra stats at key points in a game.
